snippet.title: Be My Horde Gameplay Trailer  - Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist here - store.steampowered.com/app/2499520

Be My Horde is a Bullet Hell roguelike where you play as a commanding necromancer overseeing a loyal army of minions. A new trailer aired during the Summer Showcase, providing a closer look at the 'raise and conquer' gameplay loop in this villainous indie gem. Be My Horde is out now on PC.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
